title: Repair actual scheduled reconciliation incident causal telemetry and canonical lineage transport
summary: Repairs scheduled reconciliation incident causal telemetry linking to emit exactly one deterministic causal telemetry event ID from genuine stored owner evidence while preserving complete provenance in evaluation records. Aligns TelemetryLineageLookup and Compose service tenant configuration to support canonical lineage transport fail-closed without inventing credentials or falling back to benchmark corpora.

acceptance_verification.description: Diagnosed actual evaluations and incident delivery errors with exactly-one telemetry event failure and lineage transport missing errors without requesting VM credential or second lease.

Repaired _scheduled_drift_report to derive exactly one causal telemetry event ID deterministically (last_heartbeat_event_id for runtime health, last_event_id for execution drift) satisfying incidents consumer cardinality constraint (len == 1) while retaining full evaluation evidence_refs provenance.

Aligned TelemetryLineageLookup to resolve PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_API_URL and PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_TENANT_ID with default tenant fallback and fail-closed error handling; updated docker-compose.yml telemetry service tenant fallback chain without inventing tokens or using corpus fallback as hosted truth.
Exercised genuine warning and critical incident paths in scheduled reconciliation without changing financial math, thresholds, or personas.
Six declared artifacts scoped strictly; net production lines (+9) well within budget (<= 40); verified with pytest suite.
Source-only QA delivery ready for independent review and native delivery.
